headlines.text: It was 2025 when gold changed shoulders as the AEW TNT Title found a new champion as Kyle Fletcher vs. Dustin Rhodes battled it out in a Chicago Street Fight match, appearing on Collision, rated 8.73 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. In a bloody Chicago Street Fight filled with thumbtacks and a low blow, Fletcher dethroned Rhodes for the TNT Championship.
Flash back to 2025, when Bandido & King was no more, reborn as Brodido after 2 matches, on Collision.
On a Friday in 2025, back when Scorpio Sky made their long-awaited comeback after just under 2 years away, appearing on Collision.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when FTR vs. A.Gunn & Robinson crossed paths for the first time ever on Collision, rated 7.50 ? a well-worked match.
